# 4.21 Twenty-first assembly district.
All of the following territory in Milwaukee County constitutes the 21st assembly district:
(1) The city of Oak Creek.
(2) That part of the city of Greenfield comprising U.S. census tract 120501, blocks 3000, 3001, 3002, 3003, 3004, 3005, 3006, 3007, 3008, 3009, 3011, 3012, 3013, 3014, 3015, 3016, 3017, and 3018.
